_comment: Template vendor manifest for raylib. Copy this into the root of a raylib checkout (next to its src/raylib.h), then run `cryo vendor /path/to/raylib`. The binding generator parses the headers; the link block is merged into any project that `import vendor::RayLib`. Field names mirror ProjectConfig's [link] roles: system -> -l, search -> -L, static -> verbatim archive, with per-OS *_unix / *_windows overlays.
name: RayLib
